generationInputs.prompt: From a slightly elevated angle to the right, a woman with light brown skin, appearing to be in her late teens or early twenties with a heavier build, is seated at a table covered with a black tablecloth, set against a mystical, magical backdrop. She faces slightly to the left, her hands spread out displaying three tarot cards laid horizontally. Two additional cards, arranged in a cross formation, are partially visible beneath her hands. A winged notebook with a pencil beside it sits to her right on the table, and a podcast microphone stands in front of her. Her long, wavy dark brown hair cascades past her shoulders. Her facial expression shows a smile that reveals her upper teeth and braces. She is dressed in a sleeveless, short black dress. The mystical, magical backdrop features two framed images. On the left hangs a framed tarot card illustrating a crescent moon with a face and falling droplets, in the style of the Tarot de Marseille, marked "XVIII" at the top and "LA LUNE" beneath the illustration. To the right is another framed tarot card depicting the sun with a face, rays, and sunflowers, also in the style of the Tarot de Marseille, labeled "XIX" at the top and "LE SOLEIL" below the illustration.
